$comment: Ferguson Home runs its own storefront: a React app (Relay/Apollo, react-helmet) that is rendered on the server, so the product, price and specification markup is in the HTML while the gallery and the option widgets are rehydrated by JavaScript; window.__APOLLO_STATE__ carries the catalogue. Product URLs are /<slug>/s<productId>, a ?uid=<variantId> query picks one finish (white, white with WonderGliss, ...) and the canonical link drops that query, so product.url is always the plain product URL. Prices are US dollars: span[data-automation=price] holds the current price and sale items add a 'Was' span.strike with the regular one. Stock is plain text ('92 In Stock') and the Add to Cart button is rendered but disabled until an option is chosen, so neither tells an out-of-stock product apart: availability is not configured. The four specification tables (Dimensions and Measurements, Included Components, Characteristics and Features, Warranty and Product Information) are on the page twice, once for wide screens inside div.db-ns and once for narrow screens inside div.dn-ns; only the wide copy is read, which gives every pair once. The description is the overview paragraph of the Details tab; the two later paragraphs in it are the 'Features:' and 'Specifications:' labels of the bullet lists. Category (/<slug>/c<id>), collection and /blackfriday pages do not match. The site sits behind Akamai bot protection and answers 403 to plain HTTP clients. Chrome gets Akamai's 'Access Denied' (403) too (checked 2026-11-19), so since 2026-11-19 fetch.engine is 'ai-crawler-avalai' with ai_fetch 'web_search': the service never contacts the site; only the URL goes to AvalAI's search model (APP_AI_CRAWLER_SEARCH_MODEL, default sonar), which looks the product up on the web and returns title, price, description and specs with its sources. At least one source must be on fergusonhome.com, otherwise SEARCH_NO_RESULT. The values cannot be checked against the page, so every result carries the warning AI_UNVERIFIED and price and stock may be out of date. On 2026-11-19 sonar returned the sample product with price $156.66 and its specs. From 2026-11-13 to 2026-11-19 the site used 'duckduckgo' (alternate 'brave') with fetch.search {region us-en, title_strip ' | Ferguson Home', ignore_params uid, queries site_slug then url}, which never contacts the site and returns only title, url and the description snippet; test/e2e/fergusonhome_search_test.go keeps checking those settings. Switch back to them if the AI engine cannot get the page. The selectors below still describe the page and are checked against the saved (curl) Duravit Starck 3 undermount sink page from 2026-11-12; the AI engine does not use them, they serve if the site is switched to the http or browser engine.
